name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task states one conditional rule — each time the siren starts ringing, toggle the switch — and hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) captures it with the correct trigger, consequent, and order. Since the siren persists until the switch is toggled and only re-rings while silent, the response is owed for each ring and that ring's own toggle discharges it (owed again on every ringing step, closed by the toggle; still owed at episode end if the siren was never silenced, which is the correct failure). switch_toggled is a consequent of the condition, not an unconditional goal, so the rule-only machine with empty FINAL_STATES and the compiler's warning are valid, and no clause is added, missing, or mis-prioritized.

texts: Each time the siren starts ringing, the agent toggles the siren switch to turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
